image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, wet forest floor debris (pine needles, twigs, and soil). The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible at the top right, and the tail extends toward the bottom left. The background is textured and chaotic but consistent with a natural habitat.
